issue.title: Agent header tests show Project: fake/tmp: project_display_label prefers the project_file-derived key over meta_project since df61663204
issue.description:
Proposed by sase-1jy.4 (note #2) and sase-1jy.6 (note #1) while implementing epic sase-1jy; triaged and filed by the sase-1jy land agent.

Two ACE TUI header tests fail deterministically on master d289b664a6. Both fail in isolation on every run, and both fail on the clean base trees the phase agents stashed back to:

- `tests/test_agent_display_meta_priority.py::TestMetaPatchPriority::test_project_shown_when_no_patch`: it expects `Project: my_project` and gets `Project: fake`.
- `tests/ace/tui/widgets/test_agent_display_workflow_async.py::test_workflow_snapshot_render_reads_state_once_and_uses_parsed_data`: it expects `Project: sase` and gets `Project: tmp`.

Root cause: df61663204 ("feat(projects): show PROJECT_NAME, never directory key, via display snapshot", agent apollo.6t, no bead) changed `project_display_label()` in `src/sase/ace/tui/widgets/prompt_panel/_helpers.py`. It used to return `agent.project_display_name or str(fallback)`; it now returns `agent.project_label or str(fallback)`. `Agent.project_label` (`src/sase/ace/tui/models/agent.py`) falls back to `project_display_name_for(project_file_parent_name(project_file))`. That fallback is never `None` when `project_file` is set, so the header's `fallback` (the step-output `meta_project` / workflow project) can no longer win. Unknown keys resolve to the raw directory key (`fake`, `tmp`), which is the directory-key display the `project-labels-never-keys` decision forbids.

Fix: decide which source should win when `project_display_name` is unset. One option is to prefer the explicit `meta_project` fallback, mapped through the display snapshot, over a `project_file`-derived key. The other is to accept the new contract and update both tests so they set `project_display_name` or `project_file` deliberately. Keep `tests/test_project_display_presentation_audit.py` green either way.
